newsitem.title: USA: Union Camp sees better earnings entering Q3.
newsitem.headline: Union Camp sees better earnings entering Q3.

text.p: Union Camp Corp said Thursday it believes it is positioned for better earnings entering the third quarter.

"Demand is strong and growing across our paper product lines, backlogs are up, and prices are now rising from some of the lowest levels in history. Against this backdrop, Union Camp is poised for improved earnings as we enter the third quarter," the company said.
The company today reported lower second quarter earnings.

Union Camp said it continues to make good progress on its profit-enhancement plan, announced in December. It said it is cutting costs, realigning assets and improving customer and product mix, with the goal of increasing pre-tax earning power by up to $100 million in its existing businesses, excluding benefits from industry-wide price recovery.
